Privacy Notice

Your data, in plain words

We would rather you understood this notice than skipped it. It explains what we collect, why, who sees it, how long we keep it, and how to use your rights under the Saudi Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL).

Draft for legal review. This notice follows the structure and principles of the PDPL, but it has not yet been reviewed by Saudi counsel. Placeholders in [square brackets] must be completed before launch.

The short version

  • We collect only what we need to answer you, send you what you ask for, and run our business.
  • We ask for your agreement before we use your details, and we ask separately before we send you marketing.
  • We never sell your personal data.
  • You can see it, correct it, take a copy, ask us to delete it, or withdraw your consent whenever you like.

1. Who we are

Growth Blueprint Advisory (“we”, “us”) is the data controller for the personal data described here. We are based in Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Commercial registration: [number to be added].

Questions about your data go to our privacy contact: privacy@growthblueprint.sa. [Name or role of the person responsible for data protection to be added.]

2. What we collect, and why

WhenWhat we collectWhy
You contact us (enquiry or meeting request)Name, email, company, phone (optional), role (optional), your messageTo reply, arrange a conversation and keep a record of it
You use the Readiness ScorecardYour answers stay on your device. If you ask for the report by email: name, email, company (optional) and a summary of your scoresTo send your report and, if you agree, to follow up
You subscribe to the monthly briefEmail, name (optional), languageTo send the brief. We use a confirmation email (double opt-in)
You buy a sector briefName, email, company (optional), VAT number (optional), country, what you bought, download recordsTo process the order, deliver the files, issue a tax invoice and prevent misuse of download links
You visit the websiteLanguage and cookie choice, scorecard progress and basket (stored on your device). With your consent, anonymous usage statisticsTo make the site work and, if you agree, to improve it
Security and fair useA scrambled (hashed) version of your IP address and browser typeTo keep forms and downloads safe from abuse. We cannot read your IP address from the hash

3. Our basis for using your data

Consent is our main basis. We ask for it clearly, we keep a record of when and how you gave it, and you can withdraw it at any time. Withdrawing does not affect what we did before you withdrew.

For purchases we also rely on the need to carry out the contract with you and to meet legal duties, such as tax and accounting records. We may also rely on our legitimate interests where the law allows, for example to keep the website secure, and we make sure they never override your rights.

4. Marketing is separate

We only send marketing emails if you tick a clear, separate box, and the box is never pre-ticked. Taking a scorecard, asking an enquiry or buying a brief does not subscribe you to anything unless you choose it. Every email has an unsubscribe link.

5. Who we share it with

We do not sell personal data. We share it only with people who help us run the service, under written terms that protect it: website hosting, email delivery, our customer-relationship (CRM) system and, for purchases, the payment provider. [List the actual providers before launch.] We may also disclose data when the law or a competent authority requires it.

6. Sending data outside Saudi Arabia

Some of our providers may store or process data outside the Kingdom. If that happens, we transfer data only where the PDPL and its regulations allow, with the safeguards they require. [State the countries and safeguards once providers are chosen.]

7. How long we keep it

Enquiries and meeting requests: [24] months after our last contact, then deleted or anonymised. Newsletter: until you unsubscribe; we then keep only a minimal record that you opted out, and the proof of your consent, so we can honour your choice. Orders and invoices: for as long as tax and accounting law requires. Download logs: [12] months. Consent records: for as long as we use the data they cover, plus the period needed to show we complied.

8. Your rights

Under the PDPL you have the right to be told how your data is used, to access it, to get a copy in a readable form, to have it corrected or completed, to ask us to destroy it, and to withdraw your consent. You may also object in some circumstances. If you are a minor or someone who lacks capacity, your guardian can act for you.

Use the form below or email privacy@growthblueprint.sa. We will confirm your request and aim to answer within 30 days. We may need to check it is really you before we act, and there are limited cases where we must keep data, such as tax records. We will explain if that applies.

9. How we keep it safe

Connections to this site are encrypted. Download links are personal, signed, short-lived and limited in number. We store only what we need, we hash IP addresses, we limit who can see personal data, and we keep records of consent. No system is perfectly secure, and if a breach affects you we will tell you and the competent authority as the law requires.

10. Children

Our services are for businesses and adults. We do not knowingly collect data from children. If you think we have, please tell us and we will delete it.

11. Cookies and similar technologies

See our Cookie Policy. In short: essential storage keeps the site working, and we only use analytics if you say yes.

12. Complaints

Please talk to us first, because we would like the chance to put things right. You also have the right to complain to the Saudi Data and AI Authority (SDAIA), the competent authority under the PDPL.

13. Changes to this notice

When we make a meaningful change we will update the date and version below and, where it affects how we use your data, ask for your agreement again.
